protocol: 3-split disjoint protocol: priors from train.jsonl, val.jsonl split into val_burnin (first 1/3) + val_eval (remaining 2/3) — burn-in on val_burnin, select on val_eval (no prompt overlap between burn-in and eval), report on test.jsonl (burn-in on full val, eval on test). Epsilon-constraint selection: (1) budget-paced Pareto AUC as primary metric, (2) non-stationary Phase-2 regret as secondary. All configs within 0% of best budget-paced AUC form the feasible set; among those, lowest Phase-2 regret wins.
